children: Concentra said that Tanner Newton has been appointed chief financial officer and executive vice president, effective Nov. 1.
The health services company said Newton will continue to report to Matt DiCanio, Concentra's current president and chief financial officer, who will become president and chief executive on Nov. 1.

The company said Newton will lead its finance organization, with responsibility for accounting, financial reporting, financial planning and analysis, treasury, tax, capital markets, corporate development and investor relations.
Newton joined Concentra in January 2025 as senior vice president of strategy and finance.
